field.description: Weekly milk fat concentration during the AO sampling for animals in an experiment. AO = avond ochtend (eveningn morning) sample, taken on Tuesday evening and Wednesday morning. So 2 values per week.

Weekly milk lactose concentration during the AO sampling for animals in an experiment. AO = avond ochtend (eveningn morning) sample, taken on Tuesday evening and Wednesday morning. So 2 values per week.

Weekly milk protein concentration during the AO sampling for animals in an experiment. AO = avond ochtend (eveningn morning) sample, taken on Tuesday evening and Wednesday morning. So 2 values per week.
Weekly somatic cell count during the AO sampling for animals in an experiment. AO = avond ochtend (eveningn morning) sample, taken on Tuesday evening and Wednesday morning. So 2 values per week.
Weekly milk urea concentration during the AO sampling for animals in an experiment. AO = avond ochtend (eveningn morning) sample, taken on Tuesday evening and Wednesday morning. So 2 values per week.
An estimated daily milk fat concentration based on the AO sampling and the corresponding milk yield of that day. x
field.derivation: ISO-calendar week yield-weighted average milk fat concentration calculated across regular CRV/MPR test recordings: sum(Fat_Concentration * MilkingYield) / sum(MilkingYield). Used to derive Fat- and Protein-Corrected Milk (FPCM).

field.description: An estimated daily milk lactose concentration based on the AO sampling and the corresponding milk yield of that day.
field.derivation: ISO-calendar week yield-weighted average milk lactose concentration calculated across regular CRV/MPR test recordings: sum(Lactose_Concentration * MilkingYield) / sum(MilkingYield).

field.description: An estimated daily milk protein concentration based on the AO sampling and the corresponding milk yield of that day.
field.derivation: ISO-calendar week yield-weighted average milk protein concentration calculated across regular CRV/MPR test recordings: sum(Protein_Concentration * MilkingYield) / sum(MilkingYield). Used to derive Fat- and Protein-Corrected Milk (FPCM).

field.description: An estimated daily somatic cell count based on the AO sampling and the corresponding milk yield of that day.
field.derivation: ISO-calendar week yield-weighted average somatic cell count (1,000 cells/mL) calculated across regular CRV/MPR test recordings: sum(SCC * MilkingYield) / sum(MilkingYield).

field.description: An estimated daily milk urea concentration based on the AO sampling and the corresponding milk yield of that day.
field.derivation: ISO-calendar week yield-weighted average milk urea concentration (mg/dL) calculated across regular CRV/MPR test recordings: sum(Urea_Concentration * MilkingYield) / sum(MilkingYield).
